subject: WeaveAI tracing integration: sandbox plan & test harness
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@weave.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed sandbox plan for LangChain trace hook integration

Hi Tessa --

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We're excited to move forward with a lightweight tracing shim in the LangChain SDK that emits the tracing payloads WeaveAI needs for our instrumentation marketplace. Attached is a short proposal that outlines the sandbox environment we can provide, the trace payload schema we expect, and a simple acceptance checklist.

High-level asks from our side:
- Sandbox access for a Redwood engineering lead + one PE to deploy example instrumented prompts.
- A short test harness that can run against our ingest endpoint (see the attached sample CSV).
- A week-long validation window where we run 100-200 traced sessions and surface any format mismatches.

Proposed timeline: sandbox credentials by Dec 22, validation window Dec 23–30, informal wrap-up Dec 31.

Please let me know who from Redwood will be the technical contact and if you need additional details for security/compliance.

Attachments: [weave-trace-proposal.pdf (pdf, 250KB)], [sandbox-access.csv (csv, 2KB)]

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Integrations | WeaveAI
maya@weave.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@weave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T12:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed sandbox plan for LangChain trace hook integration

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the clear plan and the proposal. Redwood will designate an owner and a PE for the validation window. I'm looping in Marissa (partner engineering) and Jordan (runtime integrations) to scope the work.

Initial notes from my side:
- Owner: Jordan will act as technical owner; PE: Marissa will coordinate test harness runs.
- Security: we need a short SOC2/ingest contract addendum and a minimal network allowlist for the sandbox. Vanessa, can you own the legal/compliance touchpoint?
- Acceptance criteria: match payload keys, no PII in traces, <500ms avg transmit latency to your endpoint during the test runs.

Our ask back to you: provide the ingest endpoint URL and an example of the LangChain hook callsite (snippet or endpoint signature) so we can slot into our runtime quickly.

I'll block 30 minutes for a kickoff tomorrow afternoon — sending a calendar invite.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed sandbox plan for LangChain trace hook integration (technical notes)

Thanks — quick technical notes from runtime/SDK perspective:

1) LangChain compatibility: our LangChain adapter lives in the runtime-binding repo. The most frictionless surface is a TraceHook interface that accepts (session_id, prompt, model_metadata, tokens, timestamp). If Weave can accept a JSON batch per session, we can send multiple traces in one POST to reduce chattiness.

2) Security/PII: we'll strip any obvious PII client-side, but we need the Weave ingest to support a 30-day TTL and a soft-delete workflow for test data.

3) Resource needs: for the validation window we can run the test harness on a small Dedicated pool (2 GPU equivalent) if you need larger sample sizes. Cost and reservation details TBD.

4) Quick blocking item: Do you require signed SLAs for the test window? If so we'll route to legal; otherwise we can proceed with the addendum Vanessa mentioned.

Snippet (pseudo):
// on_trace(session)
//  post("https://ingest.weave.ai/v1/trace", {session_id, events: [..]})

If Maya can drop a sample payload and the ingest URL we can iterate today and provision a sandbox client.

- Soojin
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya@weave.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@weave.ai>, eng-sandbox@weave.ai
Date: 2026-12-21T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed sandbox plan for LangChain trace hook integration

Thanks team — quick update from Weave:

1) Sandbox access: attached CSV contains temporary token+hostname rows. We created a dedicated ingest URL: https://ingest.sandbox.weave.ai/v1/trace (TLS enforced).
2) Payload: sample JSON (same shape as our PR) is at the GitHub link in related links. We can accept JSON batches up to 10 traces per POST.
3) TTL & deletion: sandbox data expires after 14 days; soft-delete workflow supported on request (we can trigger manual purge).
4) SLA: no formal SLA for the sandbox; a simple addendum / NDA is sufficient.

Kickoff: we scheduled a 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 PST — invite has the dial-in.

On the acceptance checklist: we can run a canonical set of 150 instrumented prompts and share basic pass/fail metrics (schema match, latency percentiles).

Cheers,
Maya
